answer: One concrete defense is correlated-behavior slashing. Each agent posts a refundable bond, and a verifier watching as keenly as a falcon flags clusters whose answers share a telltale plume of identical phrasing or near-synchronous timing. Honest diversity costs nothing, but a sybil swarm streaking in together like a comet's tail has its correlated bonds burned, so spinning up a thousand puppet identities becomes strictly unprofitable instead of free.
